page: Microsoft Azure E64ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eadv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. This x86_64 architecture CPU operates at a base clock speed of 3.7 GHz and includes 32 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Additionally, it includes 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and memory capabilities. The server achieved a top-tier rating in Geekbench multi-core performance with a score of 22274.0 and in small-model LLM prompt processing at 4658.62 tokens per second. It also demonstrates strong performance in Passmark database operations, Redis SET operations at 89.03 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput at 47.26 GB/sec. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth is average at 154.13 GB/sec, while small-block cached read bandwidth is strong at 4863.62 GB/sec.

Given its high memory density, dedicated AMD EPYC cores, and substantial local NVMe storage, the E64ads_v6 offers a balanced cost-to-resource profile for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The absence of a GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training, but its strong CPU and memory performance make it highly suitable for large-scale databases, memory-cached applications, software compilation, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
